The offer

How marketing for 10% works.

No packages and no surprises. Every detail is here, so when we meet we can talk only about your business.

You give us 10% of your gross monthly revenue. We do all the marketing and pay for the ads out of that amount.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions.

From gross monthly revenue, before expenses. If you make €10,000 gross, you pay us €1,000. The ads are paid from this amount too.

Yes, on a fixed monthly price. Product businesses usually have thin margins, so a percentage makes no sense there for you or for us. The quality is the same.

The ads are paid from the 10%. You get no extra invoice for Meta. The monthly report shows exactly how much went into ads.

That month you pay less, because 10% of a little is a little. That's why our interests are the same as yours.
